item.title: Southern Manners
item.description: This family diner serves up hearty breakfast and lunch options, with generous helpings of Southern hospitality. Try the sunrise sampler to get a taste of all the hits: french toast, pancakes, eggs, and sausage. For lunch, try a burger that’s cooked to perfection.

item.title: Bold Rock Cidery & Tasting Room
item.description: What was once a produce warehouse in Mills River now holds Bold Rock Hard Cider production facility and tasting room. It’s the second cidery to be opened by Bold Rock, which is headquartered in Virginia. A minimum of six ciders are on tap, including the flagship Carolina Apple, a crisp and refreshing Granny Smith-style cider. Check out the bottling action by taking a free tour of the facility or by peeking through the observation window while sipping a cider at the bar. The Bold Bites Mobile Kit

item.title: Independent Bean
item.description: Henderson County’s first large-batch coffee roaster lives by a “farm to mug” philosophy. Enjoy espresso drinks and pour overs made with beans including a Rwandan peaberry and an Ethiopian Yirgacheffe, plus loose-leaf teas and baked goods. Closed Saturday to Monday.

item.title: Rutherford Thai
item.description: Rutherford Thai offers an extensive fresh and authentic menu of Thai entrées. Go beyond the traditional pad thai for more adventurous fare offered on the chef’s special menu like the duck and lychee or the siam flaming beef. Closed Sunday.

item.title: Boonchoo Thai Express
item.description: Meaning “good karma” in Thai, this express eatery serves fresh and authentic northeastern and central Thai cuisine in a comfortable atmosphere. The noodles, stir-fry, and curry dishes come in two portion sizes: hungry and really hungry. Closed Sunday and Monday.

item.title: Gȃteaux
item.description: You don’t have to fly to Paris for a decadent macaron. Former Biltmore pastry demi-chef Lindsay Cromartie whips up seasonal and locally inspired éclairs, tarts, and petite sweets in her charming downtown bakery. Gȃteaux also creates custom cakes with a variety of flavors, fillings, icings, and toppings.

item.title: HenDough
item.description: Two favorite fried fares—chicken and doughnuts—are a harmonious pairing at this eatery. For breakfast, choose between traditional biscuit options like egg and cheese, country ham, and even pimento cheese, or branch out and try an original creation. The doughnut sandwich comes with American cheese, bacon, and sausage served between a glazed doughnut. The lunch menu is built around fried chicken with salads, sandwiches, and chicken by the piece. Or, you can pick up a whole dozen doughnuts any time

item.title: Honey & Salt
item.description: This quaint café, nestled in the colorful collection of shops known as Little Rainbow Row, serves up organic and locally sourced breakfast standards and heavenly baked goods. For a hardy, protein-rich start to the day, try a breakfast skillet like the smokehouse, which comes with brisket, pimento cheese, pulled pork, hash cake, all topped off with an egg. Or try a sweet or savory option from the toast bar, served on a thick-cut multigrain slice. B L $
